messages:
indra: opened a tiny PR to modernize the onboarding quickstart for the 'hello pilot' flow. aim: single-file example, clearer auth steps, and a compact Docker run. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3720
maya: nice! can you keep a link to the legacy multi-file tutorial for users who want the full layout?
indra: yep, added a 'learn more' link to the full repo. also trimmed the text around env var fallbacks.
liam: CI flagged an accessibility alt-text nit on the inline diagram and one broken link to the SDK changelog. I'll push fixes.
indra: thanks. added an SDK init example with env fallback:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || undefined });
await client.text.generate({ model: 'rwd-3b', input: 'hello' });
```
maya: can we add a one-liner about when to use quantized dev images for faster local loops? small note in runtime tips.
indra: added a short note about quantization tradeoffs (speed vs fidelity) and suggested rwd-3b-quant for quick smoke tests.
liam: pushed link + alt-text fixes. standardized all code fences to "js" per lint.
docs-bot: CI: docs build queued ⚙️
ci-bot: preview build passed ✅  https://deploy-preview-3720--docs.redwood.ai
indra: assigning final items: @liam run linkcheck, @maya review wording for non-native English. aiming to merge today and backport to stable.
maya: quick copy pass done, looks good. merge after canary smoke.
ci-bot: canary checks passed. merged and scheduled backport to 2.1-stable.
